title: The last step runs a script that does not exist
evidence: If the user confirms (yes), execute `python compile_audit.py AUDIT_REPORT.md --yes`.
what: No compile_audit.py exists under scripts/ or anywhere else in this repo.
why: The agent reaches the end of the audit, asks a yes/no question, and fails on yes. [Assumption] The line came from a harness that shipped the script alongside the preset.
fix: Delete the question and the command. Build the page in docs/skills/knowledge/hk-writeup/SHELL.html and write it to writeup/<skill>-<subject>.html, then say where it went.

title: The report lands as markdown at the repo root
evidence: Save the final report to `AUDIT_REPORT.md` at the root of the audited project directory.
what: The repo's rule sends every page a skill makes to writeup/ at the root, which .gitignore ignores.
why: A markdown file at the repo root shows up as an untracked file in the next PR, and the page skips the house shell and voice.
fix: Replace with: build the page in hk-writeup's SHELL.html and write it to writeup/<skill>-<subject>.html at the repo root.

title: The skill opens by casting the agent as an engineer
evidence: You are a senior software engineer performing a forensic audit of a codebase to evaluate its test suite and test coverage.
what: The sentence names a role and a grading word and gives the agent no action.
why: It spends the first line of the skill on nothing the agent will do differently, and 'forensic' is the kind of word the tone doc cuts.
fix: Replace with one sentence saying what the skill makes: 'Reads the test suites in one repo and writes up where they are thin.'
